svg.aria-label: One dot per trace analyzed for $1 in the Signals agent. GPT-6-sol analyzes 38 traces with a failure detection F1 of .816; flow-1 analyzes 888, about 23 times as many, with a detection F1 of .835. Measured on 523 hard agent traces; cost includes every step of the agent run, on traces under 100k tokens.
